dataset_metadata.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Degradation Data Set (TUB LG HE4 18650)
dataset_metadata.citation: Neupert, S.; Kowal, J. Model-Based State-of-Charge and State-of-Health Estimation Algorithms Utilizing a New Free Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Dataset for Benchmarking Purposes. Batteries 2023, 9, 364. https://doi.org/10.3390/batteries9070364
dataset_metadata.funding: This research received no external funding.

cell_info.cell_notes: Final discharge voltage 2.5 V; charging end voltage 4.2 V; maximum constant discharge current 20 A; maximum charging current 4 A.

aging_modes.notes: 28 cells aged with constant current (CC) cycling; 2 cells aged with a dynamic profile derived from FUDS using the Random Pulse Method at 23 degC, DOD 100%, mean SOC 50%. Aging is described as hybrid (no strict differentiation between calendar and cycle aging). Check-up temperature equals aging temperature.

time_protocol.test_equipment: Neware battery cycler (10 V, +/-10 A); Memmert oven (45 degC); Binder temperature chamber (25 degC)
time_protocol.notes: Capacity check every 10 full-cycle equivalents (FCE); irregular full check-up. Relaxation during HPPC pulses sampled at 0.1 s (10 Hz). Dynamic aging data resampled at 1 s for algorithm validation. Worst-case degradation reaches ~1200 FCE per Figure 11.

checkup.notes: Two tiers: (1) capacity check every 10 FCE; (2) irregular full characterization consisting of 1C capacity test, incremental OCV measurement (hybrid phase), and HPPC pulse tests at different SOCs (every 10% SOC). Check-up performed at cell's specific aging temperature. Dynamically aged cells also include a validation extension with dynamic discharges and CCCV charging.

notes: The mean SOC conditions used were 35%, 50%, and 65%. Combined with DOD values of 30%, 70%, and 100%, the cycling SOC windows are: SOC 20-50% (DOD 30%, mean SOC 35%), SOC 50-80% (DOD 30%, mean SOC 65%), SOC 35-65% (DOD 30%, mean SOC 50%), SOC 15-85% (DOD 70%, mean SOC 50%), and SOC 0-100% (DOD 100%, mean SOC 50%). Cell filenames encode stress factors (e.g. HE4C01B02_T25_S000_100). Data published on DepositOnce TU Berlin repository (DOI: 10.14279/depositonce-17598). The dataset is designed for benchmarking SOC and SOH estimation algorithms and includes dynamically aged cells for validation of state estimation over full battery life.
